content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to the forum and would like to know if the integrated web-server can be used as a data logger to store information on measured values in a system, such as temperature or pressure. My application requires data storage in the most cost-effective way (ideally without adding modules). Is it feasible with the new web-server functionality in [article_no]? Does anyone have an answer? Thank you in advance for your response. [user_name]

Hi, No, it is not possible to log data using the Web-Server. However, any [product_name] base module provides data logging capabilities. There's a small internal memory that can store approximately 200 records in a FIFO buffer, or you can use an MSD card. If a card is inserted, data logging will automatically use the MSD card, allowing up to 20,000 records with new entries automatically added. With [product_name] V8, you can upload the active data log to your PC, but uploading requires switching the device to STOP mode. Hope this helps.

Thank you for your reply! So, using an MSD card for data storage is suitable for slow processes where a high volume of data may not be necessary. Is there a different approach to storing larger amounts of data if there's a need for more memory? Thank you in advance for your feedback. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], What do you mean by high memory needs? What capacity are you referring to? Are you considering data storage within the device itself or on the Micro SD card? For example, it's possible to use a Micro SD card with 4GB of storage. Best regards, [user_name]
Can the memory card be changed or removed while the device is in RUN mode? Downloading requires STOP, which is problematic for my application.
The Micro SD card should not be inserted or removed during RUN mode. Please refer to the manual, chapter 9.2.
Is there any way to access data while the device is still in RUN mode?
No, data logs can only be read in STOP mode using [product_name] software or by removing and reading the SD card on a PC.
You may utilize the [product_name] Access Tool (available as a free download from the [company_name] site). This enables recording data once per second directly into an Excel sheet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed whether the integrated web-server in [product_name] can be used for data logging without extra hardware. It was clarified that the web-server lacks data logging support. Data logging is available on the base module but is limited to internal memory or requires an MSD card for extended storage. Uploading logged data necessitates stopping the device, which some users find disruptive. A suggested alternative was using the [product_name] Access Tool to record data directly to an Excel sheet.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the integrated web-server to provide data logging functionality and support high-capacity, easily accessible data storage, avoiding the need to add extra modules or interrupt device operation.
